module freq_divbyfrac(
    input clk, rst_n,
    output clk_div
);
    localparam MUL2_DIV_CLK = 7;
    reg [2:0] cnt;
    reg clk_div_tmp, clk_div_delay_half_clk, clk_div_advance_half_clk;
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if(!rst_n) begin
            cnt <= 3'd0;
        end
        else begin
            if(cnt == MUL2_DIV_CLK-1) begin
                cnt <= 3'd0;
            end
            else begin
                cnt <= cnt + 3'd1;
            end
        end
    end
    
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if(!rst_n) begin
            clk_div_tmp <= 1'b0;
        end
        else begin
            if((cnt>=3'd0 && cnt<=3'd3)) begin
                clk_div_tmp <= ~clk_div_tmp;
            end
            else begin
                clk_div_tmp <= clk_div_tmp;
            end
        end
    end
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if(!rst_n) begin
            clk_div_delay_half_clk <= 1'b0;
        end
        else begin
            if((cnt>=3'd0 && cnt<=3'd3)) begin
                clk_div_delay_half_clk <= ~clk_div_delay_half_clk;
            end
            else begin
                clk_div_delay_half_clk <= clk_div_delay_half_clk;
            end
        end
    end
    always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if(!rst_n) begin
            clk_div_advance_half_clk <= 1'b0;
        end
        else begin
            if((cnt>=3'd1 && cnt<=3'd4)) begin
                clk_div_advance_half_clk <= ~clk_div_advance_half_clk;
            end
            else begin
                clk_div_advance_half_clk <= clk_div_advance_half_clk;
            end
        end
    end
    assign clk_div = clk_div_tmp | clk_div_delay_half_clk | clk_div_advance_half_clk;
endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by fractional values. It generates a clock signal with a fractional frequency division (3.5x), using the double-edge clocking technique to achieve half-integer division while adjusting for duty cycle imbalance. By dividing uneven clock cycles and phase-shifting them, a smooth fractional clock output is produced.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="MUL2_DIV_CLK">Number of clock cycles for fractional division.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[2:0]">Counter to keep track of clock cycles.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div_tmp">Intermediate divided clock signal.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div_delay_half_clk">Delayed divided clock signal.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div_advance_half_clk">Advanced divided clock signal.</reg>
        
        // Counter logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 3'd0;
            end else begin
                if(cnt == MUL2_DIV_CLK-1) begin
                    cnt <= 3'd0;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 3'd1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Clock division logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                clk_div_tmp <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if((cnt >= 3'd0 && cnt <= 3'd3)) begin
                    clk_div_tmp <= ~clk_div_tmp;
                end else begin
                    clk_div_tmp <= clk_div_tmp;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Delayed divided clock generation
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                clk_div_delay_half_clk <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if((cnt >= 3'd0 && cnt <= 3'd3)) begin
                    clk_div_delay_half_clk <= ~clk_div_delay_half_clk;
                end else begin
                    clk_div_delay_half_clk <= clk_div_delay_half_clk;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Advanced divided clock generation
        always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                clk_div_advance_half_clk <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if((cnt >= 3'd1 && cnt <= 3'd4)) begin
                    clk_div_advance_half_clk <= ~clk_div_advance_half_clk;
                end else begin
                    clk_div_advance_half_clk <= clk_div_advance_half_clk;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Final divided clock output assignment
        assign clk_div = clk_div_tmp | clk_div_delay_half_clk | clk_div_advance_half_clk;
    </logic_description>
</module>
